description:
Marble is a private workout journal built for fast logging, focused training, and clear progress.

Record weights, reps, distance, time, RPE, rest, notes, bodyweight, and supplements without an account, ads, or tracking. Your core data stays on your iPhone or iPad.

ADD A WORKOUT IN YOUR OWN WORDS
- Paste or type natural language, gym notation, multi-day Notes, or a Hevy or Strong CSV
- Let Apple Intelligence structure prose on device when available
- Review every workout, exercise match, set, date, RPE, rest, and note before saving
- Keep working with deterministic on-device parsing for notation and file imports
- Resume an interrupted review with your saved edits and exercise matches

LOG WITHOUT LOSING YOUR FLOW
- Repeat your last set or use Save + Next for quick logging
- See personal-record targets while you enter a set
- Start and finish focused workout sessions
- Search completed workout sessions by workout or exercise, filter by date, and review a session before repeating it
- Find individual sets and Apple Health imports in Log
- Build weekly splits and reusable sprint prescriptions
- Track rest with an in-app timer, Live Activity, Dynamic Island, and rest-complete alert

UNDERSTAND YOUR PROGRESS
- Open Progress for your Top Exercises, with personal-best weights and the dates you achieved them
- Open Details for weekly goals, estimated 1RM, personal records, and training consistency
- Review Daily Highlights in Details: a private recap of same-day progress during your chosen daily window
- Find a little motivation with 131 collected quotes, including 25 short athlete quotes; each screen shows only those that fit a single line at your text size
- Track bodyweight manually or import it from Apple Health, and correct a weigh-in if a number was wrong
- Compare strength relative to bodyweight with a per-lift DOTS score
- Explore muscle-group, rep-range, effort, supplement, and calendar views

REACH MARBLE FROM iOS
- Add the Weekly Goal widget to your Home Screen or Lock Screen
- Log a set, repeat your last set, and start or finish workouts with Siri and Shortcuts
- Find exercises through Spotlight
- Open quick logging from Control Center, the Lock Screen, or the Action button

BRING IN MORE WORKOUTS
- Import Apple Health and Apple Watch workouts
- Bring Garmin workouts through Apple Health
- Scan handwritten workouts with on-device text recognition and review before saving
- Optionally send completed strength sessions to Apple Health

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
- Export and restore a portable JSON backup of your persisted training data
- Progress photos and videos remain on your device and are not included in backup files
- No account, Marble server, advertising, or third-party tracking

Just your training, clearly recorded and clearly understood.
promotionalText: New in 2.5: find and repeat past workouts, resume your edited review, see your Top Exercises, and stay inspired with 25 new short athlete quotes.
whatsNew:
Marble 2.5 helps you pick up where you left off, see the work you have put in, and find a little motivation for your next session.

FIND AND REPEAT YOUR WORKOUTS
- Open Workout History from Log to search completed sessions by workout or exercise and filter by date.
- Open a past session and choose Repeat Workout to create an editable review draft. Check the sets, make changes, and save only when you are ready.
- Finished workouts and pasted or scanned sessions appear in Workout History. Individual sets and Apple Health imports remain in Log.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
- Interrupted workout reviews preserve edited sets, notes, dates, and exercise matches.
- Resume brings you back to your review without saving another workout. Discard Draft gives you a separate, explicit way to start over.

A MORE FOCUSED PROGRESS SCREEN
- See up to five Top Exercises, ranked by how often you log them, with each exercise's personal-best weight and the date you achieved it.
- Only exercises with a recorded weight best appear, so every row gives you a useful result.
- Open Details for charts, records, reports, body measurements, and Daily Highlights during your chosen daily window.

25 NEW ATHLETE QUOTES
- Discover 25 short athlete quotes in a collection of 131 quotes.
- Tap to advance or swipe left and right to browse in Progress and Daily Highlights.
- Quotes are selected for the available space and your text size, including Bold Text. Anything that cannot fit on one line is skipped, without shrinking, wrapping, or cutting off the words.
- Daily Highlights shows a counter for the quotes that fit your current layout.

MORE CONTROL OF YOUR SAVED DATA
- Improved backup restoration and workout-history loading.
- If the workout database cannot open, logging pauses while the original files stay in place. Retry and recovery-copy controls help you take the next step without replacing your saved workouts.

Marble remains private: no account, ads, Marble server, or third-party tracking. Progress photos and videos stay on your device and are not included in JSON backups.
